styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots, soft blush-beige #F5EBE6 for benefit and closing screens, cool studio grey #E8E5E1 for structure and comparison screens; no location backgrounds, no prop walls, no fabric-drape sets
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright even neutral studio light, large soft key from upper left at about 5600K with a fill card on the shadow side, gentle wrap contact shadow under the hem band, low contrast, matte fabric surface with visible knit texture, never over-smoothed
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte seamless white sweep and neutral matte board, no reflective tabletop, no water or glass surface
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; every piece of source on-image copy is stripped to empty callout bars, blank chips and empty table cells, so no lettering is ever rendered
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line pictograms drawn in the accent tone inside white circular mask crops; one continuous stroke, no filled shapes, no 3D icons
styleLock.presentationRules: the garment is always shown as a standalone object: laid flat on a surface, held on an invisible ghost form, or as a tight detail crop; cup shape, neckline edge, strap geometry, hook-and-eye rows and the wave-edged hem band are never redrawn; identical scale and centered placement across the set
noDrift: no brand wordmarks or store badges
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: one consistent minimal intimates catalogue visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless pure white #FFFFFF, soft blush-beige #F5EBE6, cool studio grey #E8E5E1 and exactly one lotus-pink accent #C98F86 keyed to the product; bright even neutral studio light with a large soft key from upper left at about 5600K, a fill card on the shadow side and a gentle wrap contact shadow under the hem band; matte seamless sweep and neutral matte board surfaces only, never a reflective tabletop; modern geometric sans-serif typography with all copy held as empty callout bars, blank chips and empty table cells; thin single-weight line pictograms inside white circular mask crops; the garment presented only flat on a surface, on an invisible ghost form, or as a tight detail crop with cup shape, neckline edge, strap geometry, hook-and-eye rows and wave-edged hem band never redrawn; stable product scale and centered placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no brand wordmarks, no watermarks or QR codes.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：01 白底正面穿戴图，面部下缘与肩颈入镜；02 正面穿戴+双手扶托，白色弧形箭头与底部「JELLY STRIP SUPPORT」圆角条及圆形罩杯示意图；03 后视穿戴，圆形插图「Adjustable Straps」与底部「BACK FAT SMOOTHING」条、背扣延长片实拍插图；04 3/4 穿戴，手拉肩带、下身牛仔裤入镜；05 双人前后视同框，方形构图；06 方形尺码表信息图，左上角品牌字标，含罩杯/底围英寸区间与 XS-3XL 交叉矩阵及两步测量线稿；07 双栏对比版式，左栏贬损性身体特写与虚线圈、右栏同款微笑对比，红叉与绿勾徽章及「Poor Fit/Perfect Fit」主张；08 双人大图加三张不同尺码真人缩略图、底部身形图标行与「COMFORTABLE ALL DAY」条。品类判定依据：主体为无钢圈背心式文胸（罩杯、宽肩带、后背排扣、软支撑条与波浪热熔下摆清晰可辨），故 L1 取「内衣家居服」、L2 取「女士内衣」，源 categoryPath 仅作品类提示不作依据。重要偏差声明：任务提示称源图为白底平铺与灰色隐形人台目录照，实测 8 张全部为真人穿戴实拍（仅 06 为叠版信息图），并无平铺或人台素材；为守住写作口径，本模版把穿戴展示统一转写为「白底平铺 / 隐形人台 / 局部特写」三种非人物呈现，机位与构图关系按源图保留。已剥离：品牌字标与一切源品牌信息、可辨识面孔与身份、手部与身体描写、身形与尺码包容性主张、身形图标行、全部图内英文文案原句（改为空白 callout 条／空圆角按钮／空表格单元）、红勾与红叉等判定符号、暗示他方的对比主张；06 的英寸区间、罩杯底围矩阵与 XS-3XL 码数一律不回填，改为空白参数行。Amazon 徽章与星级未出现，无需剥离。
